title: SAML 2.0 schema-aware ingestor and admin recovery runbook
creator: Maya Chen
description: Implement a schema-aware SAML 2.0 metadata ingestor plus an operational runbook that lets admins safely remediate bad metadata without taking orgs offline. This ticket covers server-side ingestion/validation, a dry-run mode for previewing mapping decisions, audit-event emission for every validation and remediation step, and RBAC v2 guardrails to ensure only authorized operators can commit changes.
acceptance_criteria: Server-side metadata ingestion validates against SAML 2.0 core XSDs and our extended attribute schema, rejecting or flagging non-conformant fields with actionable diagnostics.
Dry-run ingest mode produces a deterministic preview showing entityID mapping, certificate fingerprint diffs, assertion attribute mappings, and suggested admin actions without persisting changes.
Every ingest, validation error, and admin remediation action emits structured audit events in the audit-log pipeline (actor, org, change-type, before/after snapshot, and request-id).
RBAC v2 policy check prevents non-admin roles from committing entity changes; UI/CLI surfaces clear permission errors and next steps.
Automated e2e tests that simulate IdPs with rotated certs, missing SP endpoints, and duplicate entityIDs pass in CI, and failure modes have documented remediation steps in the runbook.
Canary rollout (10% of orgs) for 48 hours with monitoring dashboards and SLOs for metadata ingestion latency and error-rate; automated rollback hook if error-rate > 2x baseline.
Confluence runbook published with step-by-step admin remediation flows, example commands, and links to diagnostic utilities and GitHub PRs.
tasks: Design schema extension for optional attribute mappings (conform with SAML core XSDs)
Implement ingest pipeline: xml parsing -> schema validation -> semantic checks -> mapping planner
Add dry-run API flag and UI preview that shows suggested mapping and certificate diffs
Emit structured audit events for each lifecycle stage to the existing audit topic
Integrate RBAC v2 checks into commit path and add clear error payloads for unauthorized attempts
Create e2e QA harness to spin up test IdPs with forged/malformed metadata and run CI scenarios
Draft admin recovery runbook (Confluence) with step-by-step rollback, certificate rotation, and assertion replay instructions
Add monitoring charts to Console for metadata-ingest latency, validation error types, and canary health
Security review and threat model session with Product and SecOps
